name: Filename and title changes retain identity and incoming links
description: Renames a description file and title while retaining its stable identity and incoming links.

passage.quote: For example, a description can be renamed from “Commands” to “Command-line interface” without changing its id. Existing incoming links still refer to the same responsibility. Moving it under a different parent instead changes the parent relation and its passage; it does not require inventing a new identity.
